resources.string: Point at a flower or plant and tap to identify

This app uses the free PlantNet API to identify plants.

1. Go to: my.plantnet.org
2. Sign up for a free account
3. Copy your API key and paste it below.

Free tier: 500 identifications per day.
STEP 1 — Get your free API key
Visit my.plantnet.org → Sign Up → My Profile → API Keys
STEP 2 — Paste your API key below
Paste your PlantNet API key here
PlantNet is a free, open scientific project. No credit card needed.
